title: Deadline / cancel / resume
summary: Proposed configurable initial limits: Jev request 20 seconds, writing request 120 seconds, application eight minutes.
body:
Proposed configurable initial limits: Jev request 20 seconds, writing request 120 seconds, application eight minutes.

Enforce deadlines outside model calls; socket timeout alone is insufficient.

Cancel preserves completed work; interrupted upstream requests may still be billed.

Repeated identical outputs/failures or exhausted repair budget → explicit stop.
